standard_prerequisites.name: The stalk of a pullback of modules and the description of the stalks of the direct image along a homeomorphism onto a closed subset
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2192-2194 and 2208-2209, 2216-2217) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Allow the two canonical maps of the proof to be checked on stalks.

standard_prerequisites.name: The kernel of the surjection of structure sheaves as an ideal sheaf, and the induced quotient description of the local rings of the subspace
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The statement of the counted lemma and the proof at source lines 2217-2219
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the local rings of the closed subspace with the quotients of those of the ambient space and makes the annihilation hypothesis usable.

core_obligations: Unit of the adjunction: for a module on the closed subspace the proof computes the stalk of the pullback of its direct image and shows it equals the original stalk, using the two stalk descriptions and the fact that the local ring of the subspace is a quotient of the local ring of the ambient space (proof lines 2180-2195)
Full faithfulness: the isomorphism just established shows that the direct image functor is fully faithful, and exactness is part of its definition (proof lines 2195-2196)

Essential image: for a module annihilated by the ideal the proof checks that the counit map is an isomorphism on stalks, treating the points outside the closed subset, where both sides vanish, and the points of the closed subset, where the map is the tensoring with the quotient ring and is an isomorphism because the module is annihilated by the ideal (proof lines 2197-2220)
proof_roadmap: 对 Z 上的模 F，先证 i^*i_*F → F 在茎上是同构：由跨章两个茎的描述与 O_{Z,z} = O_{X,x}/I_x 得 (i^*i_*F)_z = F_z ⊗_{O_{X,x}} O_{Z,z} = F_z，故 i_* 全忠实且正合。
再设 G 满足 I G = 0，证 G → i_*i^*G 在茎上同构：x ∉ i(Z) 时 I_x = O_{X,x} 故 G_x = 0（右边也为 0）；x ∈ Z 时该映射是 G_x → G_x ⊗ O_{Z,x}，由 I_x 零化 G_x 而为同构，故 G 在本质像中。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the module category of a closed subspace with the full subcategory of modules on the ambient space annihilated by the ideal of the immersion, the direct image functor being exact and fully faithful (author lemma at source lines 2162-2177, label lemma-i-star-equivalence). The proof (source lines 2179-2220) checks the unit of the adjunction on stalks, which gives full faithfulness, and then checks the counit on stalks for a module annihilated by the ideal, splitting into the points outside the closed subset, where both modules vanish, and the points of the closed subset, where the module of the subspace is realised as a quotient of the local ring (proof lines 2180-2220). Both stalk computations are the content. H3.
